title: Mishti and the Dark Cave

pages.text: Mishti the rabbit found a dark cave near the river.
She was scared. But she heard a tiny cry inside.
Mishti took a deep breath and hopped in slowly.
Inside, a baby bird had fallen from its nest!
Mishti carried the bird out gently. The sun felt warm again.

moral: Being brave means helping others even when you feel scared.
reflection_question: When was the last time you did something brave?
